complexity.notes: Correct but quadratic. A linear solution exists: ||two pointers starting at both ends, always moving the pointer at the shorter bar inward — the shorter bar is the binding constraint on height, and shrinking the width can only help if the short bar is replaced||. That runs in O(n) time with O(1) space. Minor style point: the outer loop bound len(heights)-1 is fine but `range(len(heights))` would read more naturally since the inner loop guards the empty case.
complexity.summary: Brute force: iterates over every ordered pair of bars, computes (j - i) * min(h[i], h[j]) for each, and keeps the maximum.
